security.scope: A bounded local pathname race against an original teaching reader; no external path or real data.
security.target: Original learner reader and two synthetic files in its newly owned private directory
security.environment: Unprivileged Linux child processes under a harness with a deadline and a fresh temporary directory
security.attacker_capabilities: The teaching adversary can replace the designated final-component symlink between controlled check/use stages; the delayed variant also controls one intermediate directory link.
security.isolation: Use only synthetic SAFE and OTHER teaching-file contents, exact owned paths and explicit synchronization pipes; never follow a test link outside that directory or change host permissions.
security.defect: Authority checked against one name resolution is reused after an attacker-controlled replacement; the security property is reading only the authorized teaching object.
security.exposing_transition: Pause the reader after its check, replace the designated symlink, then resume its open/read and compare the observed synthetic marker.
security.exploitability_limits: The adversary must control the relevant name component and win the scheduled interval. Demonstrating wrong-file access does not demonstrate arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation or confinement under a different resolution policy.
security.success_condition: The vulnerable original reader returns the OTHER marker instead of SAFE, confined to the two teaching files.
security.repair: Acquire and validate the intended object under one documented descriptor/resolution policy. Match final-component-only versus full-path confinement explicitly; O_NOFOLLOW on the last component alone does not solve intermediate traversal.
security.regression: Repeat both controlled schedules against flawed and repaired readers; add a preexisting link, intermediate-link variant, failed open and descriptor-cleanup checks.
security.residual_limits: The claimed repair is bounded by the selected kernel API and threat model; exact resolution API passages must be inspected before claiming stronger confinement.
